speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Migraine with aura (specifically visual aura) presenting as a new-onset headache variant.

Given the bilateral flashing lights (scintillations) that persist regardless of eye cover, combined with the throbbing nature of the pain, this strongly suggests a migraine with aura. However, because this is a new onset for you, we must rule out secondary causes like a transient ischemic attack (TIA) or other neurological issues. Are you aware of any history of migraines or seizures in your family?
